ad=ad[(ad.obs.n_genes_by_counts>=500)&(ad.obs.n_genes_by_counts<=5500)&(ad.obs.pct_counts_mt<12)].copy()

sc.pp.scale(ad,max_value=10)

sc.pp.neighbors(ad,n_neighbors=15,n_pcs=30)
sc.tl.umap(ad,random_state=0)
for r in [.4,.6,.8,1.0]:
 sc.tl.leiden(ad,resolution=r,key_added=f'leiden_{r}',random_state=0)
 print(r,ad.obs[f'leiden_{r}'].value_counts().sort_index().to_dict())
ad.write('qc_processed.h5ad')
